name: Total addressable market

subjectOf.text: The combined total addressable market of the industries disrupted by AI, counting healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, and customer service, is likely in the hundreds of trillions of dollars.
subjectOf.abstract: The combined TAM of all disrupted industries, including healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, and customer service, is likely to be in the hundreds of trillions of dollars
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
scope_conditions: figures are approximate and subject to market dynamics and technological change

subjectOf.text: The total addressable market for LER exceeds $1 trillion, driven by the great reallocation of capital out of underperforming fixed income into equities and DeFi.
subjectOf.abstract: Based on available market analyses, the TAM for LER exceeds $1 trillion, because of the "great reallocation" of capital from underperforming fixed-income assets to higher-yielding alternatives like equities and DeFi.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: based on available market analyses as of 2025

subjectOf.text: Capturing only 5 to 10 percent of yield-driven capital flows through voucher reward merchant ecosystems would make LER a significant player in the market.
subjectOf.abstract: If LER can only capture 5-10% of these yield-driven flows through voucher reward merchant ecosystems, LER become a significant player in this evolving market segment.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: assuming a TAM above $1 trillion from reallocating capital
